scheme_name: Jharkhand State Scheduled Tribe Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme
other_conditions: Must be a native of Jharkhand.
Must belong to the Scheduled Tribe (ST) category.
Must be enrolled in a recognized educational institution registered on the departmental scholarship portal.
Must be pursuing a post‑matriculation course (degree, diploma, certificate or equivalent).
Must not be receiving any other scholarship or financial assistance from the central or state government.
Must adhere to the attendance system prescribed by the institution.
Must have an Aadhaar‑linked bank account in the student's own name.
If switching courses mid‑year, scholarship is only for the new course if no scholarship was received for the previous course in the same academic year.
benefits_summary: Provides financial assistance covering tuition, academic allowance and maintenance fees up to ₹1,00,000 for hostellers and ₹90,000 for day‑scholars, directly credited to the student's Aadhaar‑linked bank account.
